主要内容: SouthCorp Capital, Inc. finalized the cancellation of 150,000,000 shares of its common stock on February 26, 2015. As of that date, the company's outstanding share count was 99,057,315, reflecting the cancellation. The shares were held by WB Partners and were canceled without any compensation or issuance of other stock. This action was part of the company's ongoing efforts to streamline its capital structure and improve shareholder value. The cancellation was confirmed in the company's Form 8-K filing, which was submitted to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. The company's CEO, Joseph Wade, signed the report on February 26, 2015, confirming the completion of the share cancellation.
